//: Composite indexes the server's queries need. Firestore builds single-field
indexes on its own, but anything combining two fields has to be declared,
and the failure only shows up against the real service: the test double in
tests/firestore.test.ts answers every query happily, so the first time these
were missed was in production, as a 500 on the leaderboard.
Deploy with:  npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore:indexes --config config/firebase.json
Building takes a few minutes; queries fail with code 9 until it finishes.

indexes.//: leaderboard(): trophies descending, oldest account first as tie-break.
rankOf(): everyone level with this player who got there first — an
indexes.//2: equality and a range over two fields, which needs its own index.
